integrity_note: Standalone finite verifier is provided with the mathematical proof. Historical priority has been compared against available primary literature and published results, but no independent priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact gcd is proved only for the interior of odd-prime Narayana rows; composite-index rows are not classified, no existence of further Fermat primes is assumed, and exhaustive finite checks do not prove the unrestricted theorem.
title: Exact common divisors of interior Narayana counts in prime rows
